items.title: Tapehouse
items.blurb: A podcast editor where you delete words from the transcript and the tape is cut and spliced to match.

items.title: Sillage
items.blurb: A perfume shop that bottles English weather: colour blooms into the footage like ink, and the notes evaporate as you scroll.

items.title: Stillwater
items.blurb: A meditation app dealt like a hand of cards, where every out-breath ripples across the lake.

items.title: Slipway
items.blurb: A lesson you scrub with a pottery wheel that has real weight, and glaze tiles you dip.

items.title: Hollins Barn
items.blurb: A wedding barn that books like a flight: free Saturdays clatter in on a split-flap board.

items.title: Isla Rennick
items.blurb: A portfolio that is one big contact sheet: scroll and the camera flies to the circled frames.

items.title: Wildacre
items.blurb: A magazine you scroll sideways, and an app that shows what crossed your acre at 2 am.

items.title: Brookwatch
items.blurb: One storm night: watch the river rise, draw the streets at risk, warn 3,412 people.

items.title: Hallow Fell
items.blurb: One night from sunset to the aurora, with a real star chart that turns as you scroll.

items.title: Fiddlehead
items.blurb: A real fern unfurls as you scroll, then the app matches plants to your light.

items.title: Bramble
items.blurb: A dog's whole surgery day, from check-in to "he's wagging!", on one screen.

items.title: Ironvale Forge
items.blurb: Iron forged across the screen as you scroll, glowing white-hot then cooling to black.

items.title: Cimalta
items.blurb: Book every hut on a Dolomites high route in one tap, then beat the storm to the last one.

items.title: Pitchside
items.blurb: Live match intelligence: a goal broken down, pass by pass.

items.title: Halden House
items.blurb: Walk from the cliff edge into the bedroom, all driven by your scroll.

items.title: Levain
items.blurb: Reserve a warm loaf, then watch it bake live on the oven cam.

items.title: Haulwise
items.blurb: A live control room for a UK freight fleet, plus the driver app in the cab.

items.title: Abyssal
items.blurb: An 11 km dive into the ocean, guided by a hand-animated jellyfish.
